item.title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.

item.tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

answer_sheet.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
answer_sheet.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

must_haves: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.

turns.text: make a logo for my bakery

dialog.agent: What’s your bakery’s name? Any preferred colors or style—like cozy rustic, playful, or elegant? If you’re unsure, I can choose a direction.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the logo because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was created.

For **mooncrumb**, I’ve planned a cozy design: a golden croissant-shaped crescent moon, two tiny crumb stars, and rounded lowercase lettering in midnight blue on cream.

Add credits, then I can try again.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a polished, distinctive bakery logo for the brand "mooncrumb". Exact main text: "mooncrumb" in beautifully legible rounded lowercase lettering; small secondary text "BAKERY" beneath. Above the wordmark, a simple clever crescent moon shaped like a golden croissant, with two tiny crumb stars. Cozy artisanal nighttime bakery feeling, elegant yet friendly. Restrained midnight navy and warm golden butter palette on a solid warm cream background. Flat vector-style design, clean bold silhouettes, balanced spacing, generous negative space, centered composition, usable brand identity, crisp edges. No photography, no 3D, no mockup, no gradients, no extra words, no watermark.
